DAW-00A-F are landed on canonical main. A supplies peer HostRuntimeIdentity, B durable WorkspaceMemory, C exact/stale-safe FocusContext, D append-only HostShadow, E bidirectional ReconciliationService and F verified capability x exact host/runtime environment evidence feeding StudioCapabilityProfile/CapabilityResolver.

Recipes already provide host-neutral semantic multi-step planning and route resolution but explicitly do not execute, grant authority, create transactions or compile host commands. DAW-00G was selected by whole-graph comparison, not by F adjacency. It outranked Workspaces/Health UI because the truthful evidence substrate is not yet populated by a real adapter lifecycle; it outranked Song version/asset UI because ingestion is not yet consumer-complete; it outranked suggestions/templates because their persisted product model is absent; and it outranked OPS-04 because it directly unlocks blocked making journeys and all six peer DAW adapters.

DAW-00G is bounded to the observation/read side. It assembles existing WorkspaceMemory + CapabilityEvidenceMemory + FocusContextService + HostShadow into one peer-neutral adapter observation contract tied to one exact current workspace/runtime binding.

DAW-00G does not create a second workspace/Song model, does not execute host mutations, does not implement Musical IR, ARA, Link/Link Audio, portability, plugin scanning, entitlements, consumer Workspaces/Health UI or any specific DAW adapter.
All six core DAWs plus GENERIC_OTHER remain semantic peers. Historical Ableton maturity has zero scheduling, scoring or schema priority.
